## Hypothesis

H1: Employment status may predict daily free time.

H2: Daily free time may predict collectivistic attitudes.

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
Gh1Data <- read.csv("Data/processed_data/Gh1Data.csv")

Gh2Data <- read.csv("Data/processed_data/Gh2Data.csv")

#reorganize categorical variable (the employment is already the factor in the database, thus we do not need to convert it to factor again.)
table(Gh1Data$Employment)
```

## H1 - Box Plot

```{r H1Box}
#Box plot
#The line is the median; the box covers the middle 50% of responses (Q1-Q3).
#Whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR of the box edges.

Gh1box <- ggplot(Gh1Data,
                aes(x = Employment, y = Time_free_1, fill = Employment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(x="Employment Status",
        y="Daily Free Time",
        title="The relationship between employment and daily free time") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size=12)

Gh1box


```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)

```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.
Gh1viol <- ggplot(Gh1Data,
                aes(x = Employment, y = Time_free_1, colour = Employment)) + 
  geom_violin(width = 1, alpha = 0.6) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = .12, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.1)+
  labs(x = "Employment Status",
        y = "Daily Free Time",
        title = "The relationship between employment and daily free time") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size=12)

Gh1viol

```

## H1 - Raincloud Plot

```{r H1Raincloud}
#Raincloud Plot
#A raincloud combines a half-violin, a box plot, and individual responses.

  Gh1rain <- ggplot(Gh1Data,
                aes(x = Employment, y = Time_free_1, colour = Employment)) + 
  geom_rain(alpha=.5) + 
  labs(x = "Employment Status",
        y = "Daily Free Time",
        title = "The relationship between employment and daily free time") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

Gh1rain
```

## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter}
#Scatter Plot
Gh2point <- ggplot(Gh2Data,
                  aes(x = Time_free_1, y = collectTotal)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x="Daily free time",
        y="Collectivistic attitude",
        title="Relationship between daily free time and collectiveistic attitude")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

Gh2point

#Plot looks weird... why?
# nrow(h2Data)
# nrow(unique(h2Data[,c("qoa","commitment")]))


#Jitter

Gh2jitter <- ggplot(Gh2Data,
                  aes(x = Time_free_1, y = collectTotal)) + 
  geom_jitter(width=.12, height=.04,alpha=.04,size=.6) + 
  labs(x="Daily free time",
        y="Collectivistic attitude",
        title="Relationship between daily free time and collectiveistic attitude")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

Gh2jitter



```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
Gh2line <- Gh2jitter + geom_smooth(method="lm")
Gh2line

```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/H1_figure_rainCloud.png",plot=Gh1rain, width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
ggsave("figures/H2_figure_line.png",plot=Gh2line, width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
```
